events.title: ESL Classes with Evergreen Valley College (EVC) - ESL 501: Reading & Writing 1

cases.refreshed: Develop your English language skills by practicing speaking, listening, reading, writing, vocabulary, pronunciation, and grammar. This free, noncredit course, ESL 501 Reading & Writing 1, is for high-beginning English learners. It focuses on basic reading, writing, grammar, and vocabulary. Students will learn to comprehend frequently used words in context, use learned phrases and sentences to express ideas in basic writing, understand basic grammar structures, and read simplified material. Course Information: Starts: August 25, 2026; Ends: December 10, 2026; Meeting Days: Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday; Time: 10:30 AM - 12:30 PM; Instructor: Michelle N. Henninger. Before the classes start, you must complete a Guided Self-Placement (GSP). This is not a test—it's simply an assessment to help us place you in the most appropriate ESL class based on your current English level. We will assist you with the application and registration process in person at the Edenvale Branch Library. Space is limited.

Students will learn to comprehend frequently used words in context, use learned phrases and sentences to express ideas in basic writing, understand basic grammar structures, and read simplified material. This is not a test—it's simply an assessment to help us place you in the most appropriate ESL class based on your current English level. We will assist you with the application and registration process in person at the Edenvale Branch Library. Space is limited.

cases.refreshed: This week, in celebration of Native American Heritage Month, we'll learn about Jaune Quick-to-See Smith, an artist and enrolled citizen of the Confederated Salish and Kootenai Tribes. After, we'll take what we've learned to create art of our own! Join us every Tuesday as we learn about an artist or art style, then make art of our own. Recommended for ages 5-12. November Events: November 3 - Frank Buffalo Hyde (drawing); November 10 - Rangoli (Diwali craft); November 17 - Theresa Secord (weaving); November 24 - Jaune Quick-to-See Smith (map art). Free. Registration not required.

events.title: ESL Classes with Evergreen Valley College (EVC) 502: Listening & Speaking

cases.refreshed: ESL Listening & Speaking 1 - This is a non-credit, high-beginning-level ESL course. Students will learn to pronounce basic words accurately, communicate effectively, understand and use basic grammar structures, and build their foundational vocabulary. To Enroll, You Must: Complete and pass the Self-Guided Computer Assessment. This is not a test—it's simply an assessment to help us place you in the most appropriate ESL class based on your current English level. To ensure accurate results, the GSP should be completed independently and in a quiet setting, without assistance from others. Submit the registration form. To schedule your assessment appointment, send an email to marcela.guevara@sjlibrary.org. ESL 502 Course Information: Starts: August 25, 2026; Ends: December 10, 2026; Class Days: Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday; Time: 5:15 PM – 6:45 PM; Instructor: TBD. We will assist you with the application and registration processes in person at the Educational Park Branch Library. Space is limited.

events.title: Bilingual Hindi-English Storytime / द्विभाषी हिंदी-अंग्रेज़ी कहानी समय

cases.refreshed: Bilingual Hindi-English Storytime The Almaden Branch library warmly invites you to a bilingual Hindi-English Storytime for the community. This special Storytime helps children strengthen their language comprehension skills while enjoying traditional rhymes and stories from the Indian culture. Offered monthly, this engaging program is aimed for kids ages 3-10 and their families, but all ages and language abilities are welcome to join! Free. No registration required. द्विभाषी हिंदी-अंग्रेज़ी कहानी समय अल्माडेन ब्रांच पुस्तकालय समुदाय के लिए हिंदी-अंग्रेज़ी द्विभाषी कहानी समय में आपका हार्दिक स्वागत करता है। यह विशेष कहानी समय बच्चों को भारतीय संस्कृति की पारंपरिक कविताओं और कहानियों का आनंद लेते हुए उनकी भाषा समझने की क्षमताओं को मजबूत करने में मदद करता है। यह कार्यक्रम महीने में एक बार आयोजित किया जाता है और 3-10 साल के बच्चों और उनके परिवारों के लिए लक्षित है, लेकिन सभी उम्र और भाषा क्षमताओं के लोग इसमें शामिल हो सकते हैं! मुफ़्त, किसी भी आरक्षण की आवश्यकता नहीं!

events.title: Learn About 3D Printing: Presentation and Q&A

cases.refreshed: A volunteer will explain the basics of 3D printing and answer questions. You will get to see a 3D printer at work and some of the objects it can make! Please note that participants will not be able to use the printer themselves or make any items. This program is for educational purposes. Adults, teens and children welcome. Registration recommended but not required.
